entities.summary: Papua New Guinea is a sovereign nation in Melanesia, Oceania. Its capital is Port Moresby. Official languages include English, Tok Pisin, Hiri Motu. Government: Unitary parliamentary constitutional monarchy. Population: approximately 10.3 million. Area: 462,840 km². Comprehensive index for Papua New Guinea covering ancient settlement (~50,000 years, among earliest outside Africa), Kuk Swamp agriculture (earliest in world ~7000 BCE, UNESCO), extreme linguistic diversity (840+ languages, most linguistically diverse place on Earth), European contact (Portuguese 1512, Dutch, British/German partition), colonial period (British New Guinea/Papua + German New Guinea), WWII (Kokoda Track, Battle of the Coral Sea, Rabaul), Australian trusteeship (1945-1975), independence 1975, Bougainville civil war 1988-98, resource extraction (Ok Tedi, LNG), 2019 Bougainville referendum.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Papua New Guinea's linguistic diversity is the most extensive in the world, with over 840 languages spoken across its territory. This unique cultural heritage has had significant regional impact on Melanesian and Pacific Island cultures.
